senses.gloss: to read (to look at and interpret letters and symbols that are written)
to read (to look at other information and interpret that is written or drawn)
to read (to interpret, or infer a meaning, significance, thought, intention, etc.)
to read (to recognize the proper meaning of something)
to read (to fetch data from (a storage medium, etc.))
to read (to speak aloud words or other information that is written)
to read (to divine the future based on heavenly bodies)
to pronounce (to say foreign words and phrases a particular way)

etymologies.text: Inherited from Old Polish czytać. By surface analysis, czyść + -ać.
